Trying D2 = 1 gives D1 = 3, and trying D4 = 5 gives D3 = 7, so 3175 is a candidate ending satisfying the two local digit conditions.
This concludes that 3175 is the final quotient after checking only the two local digit-pattern conditions, but those conditions alone admit many endings, including the given examples 9742 and 3186. Therefore 3175 is only one candidate, not the unique solution.
